'''Battle droid 513''' was kept by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] for target practice. This particular [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was created from the cobbled remains of a [[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Caucus]] [[LR-57 combat droid/Legends|LR-57 combat droid]], a standard [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]], and a [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droid]], with a deep [[Vocabulator/Legends|Vocabulator]].

==Biography==
He was present on [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arrived. Being too slow to avoid the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, he was damaged by the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. When R2-D2 was sent to repair them, battle droid 513 and the other [[Droid/Legends|droids]] implored him to reassemble them. While the Death Watch went to the [[Ming Po town]] and engaged Tano, R2-D2 successfully repaired the droids. When R2-D2 observed Tano captured by the Death Watch he asked the droids, including battle droid 513, to help him rescue her. R2-D2 managed to distract the Death Watch and passed Tano her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. As she dueled [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the leader of Death Watch, the fight, as well as the warriors shifted outside. There, with Bonteri, R2-D2, and the other droids, battle droid 513 engaged the warriors. Eventually he was shot by a Death Watch warrior and fell over.<ref name="FiN">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref>
